content.scenario: Rahul, a consumer from Mumbai, purchases a defective product from a company that has its head office in Delhi and a branch office in Mumbai. Rahul wants to file a complaint against the company.
content.outcome: Rahul can file a complaint in the State Commission of Maharashtra, as the company has a branch office in Mumbai, which falls within the territorial jurisdiction of the State Commission.

user_queries: Where can I file a complaint against a company with a branch office in my state?
Can I file a complaint in the State Commission of the state where the company has its head office?
What is the jurisdiction of the State Commission in consumer protection cases?
